fact: The IMF TADAT assessment of October 2025 states that e-filing is mandatory for all taxpayers, over 90% of declarations and payments are electronic, and in 2024 electronic payments were 92.9% of corporate tax, 75.4% of personal income tax and 95.5% of VAT collected by value.
title: Maroc: Rapport d'assistance technique - Rapport d'évaluation de la performance, n° 25/108
